candidate_change: The wallpaper catalog library loads again.  In v241 it named MobileGestalt by a path that does not exist on this system, so dyld could not load it and SpringBoard and chronod died at every start: v241 never reached its UI.  The real install name is /usr/lib/libMobileGestalt.dylib.

The partition table of the LUN that holds the modem and Wi-Fi firmware is checked with retries: in v239 and v241 (the first two boots from flash) the single check two seconds into the boot failed, so the Wi-Fi firmware could not be read, the modem firmware chain never ran and the audio processor that publishes the battery never started.  A failed check is now retried with growing pauses, every failure records the step and the device's answer, and the radio driver waits for the table (at most 45 seconds) instead of giving up.
Every library the injected libraries load is compared with the names Apple's own binaries use.

Carried unchanged: the interface-namer marker and the en0 listing in configd (Settings -> About), the panic record slot (v238), the Settings hang dump with symbols (v238), protection classes A and B open for every process and IOSurface selector 21 (v237), the v236 GPU timing hook, the v235 witness.  No boot argument changed.
